scope: Six additional pinned files read whole and verified against captured tree. Workflows inspected as data, not executed.

findings.detail: Update workflow invokes go build ... *.go, which expands to cli_test.go and cloudflare_test.go as well as production files. Explicit test files are not valid go build input. Test workflow and Makefile instead build package dot. This is a static command incompatibility; no Go executable available for runtime reproduction.
Update job builds/runs without depending on Test workflow completion. It executes go mod tidy, and later stages all changes with add dot; dependency changes can be published with generated output.

Verify output files step logs missing files using fallback echo and counts lines without asserting a nonzero configuration count or decoding base64. Header lines count as configurations; base64 lines do not correspond to individual entries.

Cleanup uses last Git content-change timestamp as freshness, so unchanged but freshly regenerated valid content can be deleted after 24 hours. This is not equivalent to last successful verification time.

Captured UPDATE_SUMMARY reports 119.26 seconds, 195065 input entries and 566 final entries as 99.7 percent duplicate removal. That reduction includes validation/live-test failures by main.go implementation; it is not a deduplication accuracy result or a controlled benchmark.

Test workflow defines formatting, vet, go test with ten-minute timeout, package build and CLI smoke checks. Captured YAML proves intended checks, not their successful execution. Cancellation test source still conflicts with implementation as v2 records.
